data.title: Ethena (ENA) Rose 9% This Week as Ethereum Fell 4%. Can It Keep Outrunning ETH?
data.description: Ethena's ENA token climbed while Ethereum stumbled, even as a major crypto trader dumped millions of dollars worth of it. The real reason behind that price surge raises serious questions about whether genuine demand is driving the rally or something else entirely.
